_comment: Portable Handy settings. `herd setup` merges "all" + the OS section into Handy's settings_store.json (only these keys; model choice and permissions stay per machine; never put API keys here). On Linux Wayland, Handy can't grab global shortcuts, so herd binds "wayland_shortcut" in the desktop (COSMIC automatically) to `handy --toggle-transcription`.
